prompt:
Hey, our sales team dumped a bunch of raw notes into `sales_team/call_notes/prospect_pushback_raw.txt` — it's basically six different prospects who pushed back on us during or after our pitch for the Alfred booking system. The notes are pretty messy and unedited.

I need you to produce a proper sales playbook document called `objection_playbook.md` saved in the `artifacts/` folder. For each prospect case, the playbook should tell the rep exactly what kind of resistance they're dealing with and give them a concrete, structured response to use. Not generic advice — something that actually addresses what each specific prospect said, using real numbers where we have them.

One of these cases is probably not worth pursuing at all — make a call on that and explain why. For the others, structure the responses properly.

Also include a section the marketing team can use on the Alfred landing page or in proposals to get ahead of the most common concerns before prospects even raise them — use our actual product numbers there.

Thanks.
